subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the stale linked PR, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or leave this issue parked until another current-main fix owns the Dashboard recovery path?
rationale: The remaining path depends on ownership of a stale proof-gated PR and current-main UI/Gateway lifecycle semantics, not a narrow safe issue-to-PR repair lane.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using the current filtered active-run and chat lifecycle helpers.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original contributor can update the linked branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Keep parked behind the linked PR
options.body: This issue can stay open without a new repair lane until the linked candidate PR lands, is replaced, or is closed.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using the current filtered active-run and chat lifecycle helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main chat lifecycle and session active-run surfaces that the fix must align with are most recently owned by this history.
